headline: Canada and UAE Sign Comprehensive Trade Agreement to Cut Barriers
summary: Canada and the United Arab Emirates have signed a comprehensive trade deal designed to reduce bilateral trade barriers and attract reciprocal cross-border investments.
why: Bilateral trade deals between resource-rich nations help diversify commerce and secure foreign direct investment outside traditional regional trading partnerships.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Lowered trade barriers open Gulf capital markets and boost exports for Canadian businesses.

impacts.name: United Arab Emirates
impacts.why: The pact supports investment inflows and commercial ties with North America.
